x.d: Long cylindrical watermelon with broken stripes, bred by Charles V. Hall at the Kansas Agricultural Experiment Station, Manhattan, from (Miles x Peacock) x Charleston Gray; released 1972.

notes: Charleston Gray (USDA-type, Charleston SC, 1954), Crimson Sweet (Kansas State, 1963) and Jubilee (Florida, 1963; 35-40 lb) confirmed on cucurbit.info; Sugar Baby not listed there so stays out.
